questions.question: List the characteristics of Laissez-faire leadership.
questions.solution_html:
• Laissez-faire leadership is characterized by minimal supervision and high freedom for
  • employees in decision-making. Employees are trusted to manage their own tasks with
  • little direct control from the leader.
questions.final_answer: little direct control from the leader

questions.question: Critically explain the meaning and characteristics of leadership.
questions.solution_html:
• Leadership is the ability to influence and guide individuals or groups toward achieving
  • organizational goals. Effective leadership is characterized by vision, communication
  • skills, integrity, and the ability to motivate others.
questions.final_answer: skills, integrity, and the ability to motivate others

questions.question: Describe LMX theory with reference to leader–follower relationships.
questions.solution_html:
• LMX theory explains leadership through the relationship quality between a leader and
  • each follower. High-quality relationships result in trust, support, and better
  • performance, while low-quality relationships remain formal and limited.
questions.final_answer: performance, while low-quality relationships remain formal and limited
